d: MLC Election 2026 ki siton ke natijon ke bad mahagathbandhan (RJD-kangres) ke bhitar shuru huee aapsi khinchtan ab khuleaam jubani jang men tabdil ho gaee hai. kangres ke rajyasbha sansad aur purv bihar pradesh adhyaksh akhilesh sinh dvara rajad ke chunavi netritv aur natijon par saval uthae jane ke bad rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ne behad sakht aur talkh tevar apnate hue palatvar kiya hai.
